changes.rationale: M8.1a adds a new provisional clipboard crate without removing or changing any accepted M7 public symbol.

M8.0 changes the provisional public ParityError::Mismatch expected and actual payloads from ParityResult to Box<ParityResult> to bound enum size under strict Clippy. Downstream code that constructs this variant must wrap payloads with Box::new, and code that destructures it must handle boxed values.
